# okstatus_maintenance (Resource)

A scheduled maintenance window for one or more monitors.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "okstatus_monitor" "db" {
  name = "Primary database"
  url  = "tcp://db.example.com:5432"
  type = "tcp"
}

resource "okstatus_maintenance" "db_upgrade" {
  title           = "Database upgrade"
  message         = "Scheduled PostgreSQL major version upgrade."
  scheduled_start = "2026-09-01T02:00:00Z"
  scheduled_end   = "2026-09-01T04:00:00Z"
  monitor_ids     = [okstatus_monitor.db.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `monitor_ids` (List of String)
- `scheduled_end` (String) ISO-8601 datetime.
- `scheduled_start` (String) ISO-8601 datetime.
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `message` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) One of `scheduled`, `in_progress`, `completed`, `cancelled` — set by OKStatus based on the schedule, not user-writable at create time.
